stories.title: 65-year-old woman killed in shark attack off South Africa's east coast
stories.summary: Janine Lochrenberg, 65, was killed while swimming off a beach in KuGompo City (formerly East London) on Tuesday morning. Witnesses said she was bitten in two places and died before fellow swimmers could get her ashore. The attack is South Africa’s first fatal shark incident recorded this year, and the country has had about ten fatal attacks since 2012, according to the International Shark Attack File.
stories.why: The incident highlights the risk to open‑water swimmers and informs coastal safety planning.

stories.title: Federal Bank named in Economic Times market trading guide
stories.summary: The Economic Times published a market trading guide titled “Market Trading Guide: Federal Bank among 4 stock recommendations for Wednesday.” The guide listed Federal Bank as one of four stocks suggested for investors to consider on that Wednesday. The article is located in the Markets > Stocks > News section as a slideshow.
stories.why: The recommendation may raise investor awareness and affect trading interest in Federal Bank.

stories.title: Houthi missile strike kills more than 70 security recruits in Shabwa, Yemen
stories.summary: On Monday the Iran‑backed Houthi movement launched three ballistic missiles at al‑Alam training camp near Ataq in Yemen’s central Shabwa province. The strike killed more than 70 recruits serving in the government’s internal security forces and police. Yemen’s Presidential Leadership Council condemned the attack as a criminal act and said a firm response would follow.
stories.why: The attack underscores the rising intensity of the conflict as pro‑government forces start a major offensive to retake Houthi‑held western territories.

stories.title: India-NZ FTA in force: Over half of New Zealand’s exports to India now tariff-free, Wellington also eyes Brazil, Canada
stories.summary: New Zealand is working to strengthen trade relations with Brazil and Canada in response to economic uncertainties. A new free trade agreement with India has been implemented, making more than half of exports tariff-free.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.

stories.title: Rubio says India‑US trade deal is “very, very close” after meeting with Jaishankar
stories.summary: US Senator Marco Rubio said the India‑US trade deal is “very, very close” following discussions with Indian Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar. He noted that the talks covered energy security and defence cooperation, while tariff and energy tensions remain challenges. Rubio’s India visit also included a tour of the Reliance Industries refinery and meetings with business leaders.

stories.title: Marco Rubio arrives in Mumbai to advance India‑US trade talks
stories.summary: US official Marco Rubio arrived in Mumbai as part of a visit aimed at strengthening cooperation on energy, trade and defense under the India‑US Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership. The trip follows a May visit in which he met Prime Minister Narendra Modi and External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar. Officials say the pending bilateral trade agreement seeks to resolve tariff barriers and improve market access for both countries.
stories.why: The agreement could lower tariffs and expand market opportunities for businesses and consumers in India and the United States.
